Return the supplied JSON schema. forbidden_rendering means photo, 3D rendering, watermark or generated readable labels. overhead_view means framing requested in this particular brief, including portraits or flat UI sheets when requested. style_match checks Covenant: painted volume, worn material edges, quiet broad surfaces, no paper or all-over grain. required_content checks the requested subjects and sheet count. Readability 0 absent, 1 confused, 2 local ambiguity, 3 clear. Use uncertain if unsure. Do not mistake flat magenta extraction matte for a style failure. Describe concrete defects in fewer than 100 words. EXACT BRIEF: ONE square sprite sheet, 2 by 2 grid with FOUR separated full-body keys of the SAME entity. Reference-1.png is the camera/scale/paint reference: copy its high oblique REAR THREE-QUARTER camera, looking down at hood/back/shoulder tops and short compressed legs. Reference-2.png is world material and lighting. NEW ENTITY: Lean adult man, copper skin, long black hair tied high behind swept pale lilac hood, ivory layered cloth with two narrow trailing lilac panels, silver wire charms and belt tools, slender bifurcated silver-bound staff. Sparse wind wisps and tiny branching lightning.
Read order poses: ready, running, staff casting, one hand forward absorbing. All face AWAY toward UPPER RIGHT, never frontal. High 55-60 degree oblique game camera, no horizon. Whole entity and equipment inside each quadrant with at least 12 percent margin; centred in cell. Four clearly distinct poses. Painterly broad volumes, dark readable silhouette, selected cool edge highlights. Staff, accessories, light coloured layered cloth and compact elemental energy. Solid uniform vivid magenta #FF00FF background. No shadow on matte, no floor, panel lines, labels or text. No grain, paper or canvas texture. No injuries, gore or anatomical damage. Original 2D art.
